title: Concept: JWT 'none' algorithm (json) — review required
description: In json, "alg"s*:s*"none" names unsecured JWTs. The 'none' algorithm exists for special cases, but verifiers that accept it let attackers forge any claim. The remedy is pinning HS256/RS256 pinning.
applicability: json JWT verification configuration; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Authentication bypass via self-minted tokens; HIGH severity.
